key_insight: TCA-SIR reframes scientific inspiration retrieval as generating a transferable, target-conditioned abstraction rather than merely ranking papers by topical similarity.
engineering_relevance: This enables retrieval systems for AI for Science to surface remote but reusable problem-solving principles, improving both retrieval quality and interpretability for hypothesis generation.
method: Learns to generate a target-conditioned abstraction from each candidate paper.
Uses the abstraction representation to predict how well the candidate transfers to the target problem.
Retrieves inspirations that better match the target’s underlying mechanism, not just its topic.
evidence_signal: On ResearchBench, TCA-SIR outperforms prior SIR methods and direct LLM retrieval, improving HitRate@top4% over MOOSE-Chem by more than 10 percentage points.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on learned abstractions, performance may be sensitive to prompt design, representation quality, and how well the model generalizes to truly novel scientific domains.
paper_title: TCA-SIR: Learning Target-Conditioned Abstractions for Scientific Inspiration Retrieval
